title: Removed source material does not survive as a stale generated file
statement: After deleting an artifact and republishing, the package contains no trace of it.
notes: Evaluated by test/handoff.test.mjs. ⚠️ `pass` here means the condition was RUN and held, not that someone judged the code good — and #144 records the residual honestly: these criteria were written by the same agent that wrote the code, which is a weaker independence than a separate reviewer would give.
